meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写 FCS(流式细胞术标准)2.0/3.0/3.1 文件:解析元数据与通道信息、把事件数据提取为 NumPy 数组或转成 CSV/DataFrame,也能用数组新建 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要解析 FCS 文件的元数据或通道信息、把事件数据转成 NumPy/CSV,或从数组生成 FCS 文件时触发;文件含多个数据集时会改用 read_multiple_data_sets 读取。

howto.what_en: Claude can read and write FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files: parse metadata and channel info, pull events into NumPy arrays or CSV/DataFrame, and create FCS 3.1 files from arrays.
howto.when_en: Use when you need FCS metadata or channels parsed, events as NumPy/CSV, or a FCS file built from arrays; multi-dataset files go through read_multiple_data_sets.
